title: Sloth eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tree branch -->
  <rect x='5' y='55' width='90' height='10' rx='5' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <rect x='5' y='55' width='90' height='4' rx='2' fill='#A8763E'/>
  <!-- sloth body -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='62' rx='22' ry='16' fill='#9C8468'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='60' rx='18' ry='12' fill='#B49B7D'/>
  <!-- sloth arms hanging over branch -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='62' rx='6' ry='9' fill='#9C8468'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='62' rx='6' ry='9' fill='#9C8468'/>
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='50' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#B49B7D'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='50' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#B49B7D'/>
  <!-- sloth head -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='44' r='14' fill='#B49B7D'/>
  <!-- face mask -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='46' rx='9' ry='8' fill='#E8D8C0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='42' r='2.5' fill='#3A2A1A'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='42' r='2.5' fill='#3A2A1A'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='41' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='41' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='47' rx='2.5' ry='2' fill='#5A4030'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M41 50 Q45 54 49 50' stroke='#5A4030' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- snack: leaf held near mouth -->
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='50' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#4CAF50' transform='rotate(-20 55 50)'/>
  <path d='M50 52 Q55 48 60 51' stroke='#2E7D32' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none'/>
  <line x1='55' y1='50' x2='61' y2='45' stroke='#2E7D32' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <!-- sloth paw holding snack -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='52' rx='4' ry='3.5' fill='#9C8468'/>
  <!-- little claws -->
  <line x1='27' y1='58' x2='25' y2='54' stroke='#E8D8C0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='30' y1='58' x2='29' y2='53' stroke='#E8D8C0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='63' y1='58' x2='65' y2='54' stroke='#E8D8C0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='60' y1='58' x2='61' y2='53' stroke='#E8D8C0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='65' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#9C8468'/>
</svg>
